title: Metacrafter Registry semantic datatype
description: Source YAML record of a semantic datatype (data/datatypes/**/<id>.yaml). Empty values are not allowed: omit the field instead.

id.description: Lowercase identifier: letters, digits and underscores

cdmTrait.description: A trait name from the CDM foundations, for example means.location.postalCode or is.dataFormat.guid

autotypeCase.description: An AutoType benchmark test case: the name of its data_release file without .txt, for example isbn, date-chinese or ssn - new

d3mType.description: A D3M semantic type URI as D3M metadata writes it, for example https://metadata.datadrivendiscovery.org/types/FileName or http://schema.org/email

sherlockType.description: One of the 78 Sherlock semantic types, spelled as the trained model returns it (model_files/classes_sherlock.npy of mitmedialab/sherlock-project), for example city or birth Date

ftaType.description: An FTA (Fast Text Analysis) semantic type as FTA documents it, for example EMAIL, COUNTRY.ISO-3166-2 or MONTH.FULL_<LOCALE>

gs1Ai.description: A GS1 Application Identifier as GS1 writes it, with its leading zeros and without parentheses, for example 01, 414 or 8003

orgidCode.description: An ORG-ID.guide list code, for example GB-COH, XI-LEI or CA_ON-ONT

qddateKey.description: The key of a qddate date pattern (ivbeg/qddate, qddate/patterns), for example dt:date:date_2. Generated variants such as dt:date:date_2:time_1 are not mapped; crosswalk resolves them to their base pattern.

bioregistryPrefix.description: A normalized Bioregistry prefix, lowercase, for example chebi, ncbitaxon, pubchem.compound or iso.639-3

stdnumModule.description: A python-stdnum module path without the stdnum. prefix, for example br.cpf, iban or in_.aadhaar

fhirSystem.description: An HL7 FHIR identifier system: an http(s) URI, urn:oid: or another URN, for example http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn or urn:dicom:uid

mispType.description: A MISP attribute type as the MISP core format and describeTypes.json write it, for example ip-src, email, vulnerability, sha512/256 or AS

status.description: draft: not reviewed yet (for example generated from a rule key); stable: reviewed; deprecated: do not use, see replaced_by

semantic_type.description: Patterns only: the datatype this pattern represents

aliases.description: Former IDs of this record (for example after merging duplicates). They keep resolving forever.

country.description: Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes from data/countries.yaml

langs.description: ISO 639-1 codes from data/langs.yaml; 'common' means language-independent

regexp.description: Python re syntax; anchored with ^...$; no possessive quantifiers or atomic groups

checksum.description: Name of the check-digit algorithm, for example luhn or iban_mod97

valid.description: false marks a negative example: it must not match

fibo.description: FIBO class: its IRI without the https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/ prefix, e.g. FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccounts/InternationalBankAccountIdentifier

d3m.description: D3M semantic type URIs, for example http://schema.org/email

sherlock.description: Sherlock semantic type labels, for example birth Date

autotype.description: AutoType benchmark test cases (data_release file names without .txt), for example isbn or date-chinese

cdm.description: Microsoft Common Data Model trait names, for example means.identity.service.email

fta.description: FTA (Fast Text Analysis) semantic types, for example EMAIL or POSTAL_CODE.ZIP5_US. Locale-bound types keep FTA's <LANGUAGE>, <COUNTRY> or <LOCALE> placeholder.

gs1_ai.description: GS1 Application Identifiers (https://ref.gs1.org/ai/) that this record represents, for example 8003. Each AI maps to at most one record: the element-string record of the AI when the registry has one, otherwise the record of the value the AI carries (8007 maps to iban).

orgid.description: ORG-ID.guide list codes of the organization identifier lists that use this identifier, for example GB-COH. Deprecated codes that ORG-ID.guide replaced with a listed code may follow the current ones.

qddate.description: Keys of the qddate date patterns that read this notation, for example dt:date:date_2. Each key maps to at most one record.

bioregistry.description: Bioregistry (https://bioregistry.io) prefixes of the identifier resources whose local identifiers this record describes, for example chebi or ncbitaxon.

stdnum.description: python-stdnum modules that validate this identifier, as the module path after stdnum., for example br.cpf, iban or in_.aadhaar.

fhir.description: HL7 FHIR identifier system URIs (Identifier.system) for this identifier, as HL7 Terminology (terminology.hl7.org) or the base implementation guide of a national HL7 affiliate publishes them, for example http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn or https://fhir.nhs.uk/Id/nhs-number.

misp.description: MISP attribute types (https://www.misp-project.org/datamodels/) whose values are this datatype, for example vulnerability for a CVE id or mac-address. Directional types such as ip-src or email-dst are mapped only by records that are directional themselves.
